messages.subject: Traversence: the site's own email works
messages.body: This is the first message sent by the site itself, not by Claude. Today's batch is live: P3-3 (the tiers), P3-4 (agent Undo and the $0 limit), P3-5 (tribal-land names held) and this email. P3-6, the backend fence, is next. Each has Roll back at https://traversence.com/admin/config/releases. Still yours: the three staging switches at https://traversence.com/admin/config/staging

messages.subject: Traversence: staging fix waits until about 2 AM (option A); nothing for you tonight
messages.body: No answer on A or B, so it's A: staging's closed marker expires around 08:55 UTC (1:55 AM Arizona). The fix (#299) and #298 are then resent and go through staging normally; live is unaffected. In the morning, on https://traversence.com/admin/config/staging#against, press Try again in Staging against live (about 30 minutes; an email when it reads (on)). Then: staging's runner switch at https://staging.trvgo.us/admin/config/switches, and Approve the decision tree on https://traversence.com/admin/config/team. Press nothing else on the Staging page.

messages.subject: Traversence: staging is fixed, one press when you're up
messages.body: The staging fix is live (#300) and checked. When you're up: open https://traversence.com/admin/config/staging#against. In "Staging against live" it reads "Keep staging caught up didn't turn on…". Press Try again. You'll see "turning on" with a percentage; about 30 minutes later it reads (on) and you get an email. Then: https://staging.trvgo.us/admin/config/switches, set Staging: the Team's runner to Everyone and Save. Then https://traversence.com/admin/config/team: Approve the decision tree, Raise to Building, Raise to Implementation.

messages.subject: Traversence: R1 is live, three presses for you
messages.body: R1 (Release #313) is live and checked: the five tiers and all 32 roles on, plus the 12 advocates. Open https://traversence.com/admin/config/team and press, in order: 1. Approve the decision tree (the five-tier version). 2. Raise to Building. 3. Raise to Implementation. Agents then build backend releases on their own: Backend only, $0 spend (yours and the CEO's $20 aside), no real money moved. While you're there, check the roster shows 44 active and 0 on standby; I couldn't read those counts from outside. Next: the before-and-after check's fix, the check switched back on, then R2.
